docs: References core and golden-images, which is the whole architecture of this tool in
two lines: golden-images defines what the right answer is, packages/core is half of
Song-level F1 runs the extractor over the OCR text, so this measures the ENGINE AND
THE GRAMMAR together. That is deliberate and it is why the harness is TypeScript
(ADR-014): an engine whose errors fall on characters the grammar ignores is the
better engine for this product, and only a metric that runs both can say so.
